meta.title: MCP tool ontology - servers, tool groups, broad categories
meta.frame: Broad-category routing map of every MCP server/connector available to Claude Code on this machine. Nodes: category (what a tool is for), server, tool_group (a server's tool namespace, with its tools listed). Relations: provides, in_category, overlaps_with (interchangeable/duplicate tool groups - the routing ambiguity), feeds (category-level workflow). Not an ontology/ financial graph: it does not use taxonomy.json.
meta.source: tool names from the session's tool list; tool_group.tools is abridged, not exhaustive. Regenerate via live tools/list introspection for exact schemas.
meta.often_follows_source: ~/.claude/claude_hooks.sqlite hook_logs `PTU enter` lines; regenerate with scripts/mine_tool_sequences.py

relation_types.in_category: tool group serves this broad purpose
relation_types.overlaps_with: two tool groups can do the same job - choose by constraint
relation_types.feeds: output of source category is typically input to target category
relation_types.often_follows: mined from PostToolUse `PTU enter` log lines: target is called next (MCP calls only) after source within one session (count; p = share of the source's successors)
relation_types.member_of: tool belongs to the tool group
